purpose: Teach: 君主/真空/放射能/被爆/高官/元来/堕落/精霊

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、君主制の国にも進出しろ
lines.en: I want us to expand into monarchies as well.
lines.style: Crisp, measured opening. No hesitation — this is a directive. Even, authoritative pace. Slight pause before 'monarchies' to let the scope register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。真空パック技術を新製品に導入します
lines.en: Yes. We're implementing vacuum-pack technology in our new product line.
lines.style: Steady, professional. Quick acknowledgment on 'Yes.' Calm, methodical delivery of the plan. No embellishment — just the facts, clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 放射能対応の保険商品を検討しろ
lines.style: Direct, measured. Light emphasis on the scope. Pause between clause and directive — this matters, let it land. Quiet authority, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被爆国向けの安全機器を開発中です
lines.en: Yes. We're developing safety equipment for markets affected by radiation exposure.
lines.style: Clear, factual report. Slight pride in the 'we're developing' — this is already underway. Steady pace, professional register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、政府高官との関係も大切にしろ
lines.en: And we need to maintain strong relationships with government officials.
lines.style: Shift to broader scope. Quiet weight on 'relationships' — this isn't transactional, it's strategic. Even tone, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、元来の社是を社員に再徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We'll reinforce our founding principles with the entire staff.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight emphasis on 'founding principles' — there's pride in legacy here. Measured, earnest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: We won't tolerate decline in this industry.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Hard stop on 'won't' — this is a line. Quiet intensity, not anger. The weight of principle, not emotion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。精霊崇拝に基づく商品も検討しております
lines.en: Yes. We're also considering products based on spiritual values and respect.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Measured, professional. Small pause before 'spiritual values' — acknowledging the breadth of consideration. Even close.
